statement: You are given an array prices, where prices[i] is the price of a stock on day i.
You may make as many trades as you like, but you can hold at most one share at a time: you must sell before you buy again. Buying and selling on the same day is allowed.
Return the largest total profit you can make.

examples.explanation: Buy at 1 and sell at 5 (+4), then buy at 3 and sell at 6 (+3), for 7 in total.
The price never rises from one day to the next, so no trade makes money.
